rows.question: What is the average age of the dogs who have gone through any treatments?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT AVG(dc.age_num) AS average_age
FROM (
  SELECT
    dog_id,
    age AS age_raw,
    CASE
      WHEN trim(age) = '' THEN NULL
      WHEN age GLOB '-?[0-9]*' THEN CAST(age AS INTEGER)
      WHEN age GLOB '-?[0-9]*.[0-9]*' THEN CAST(age AS REAL)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS age_num
  FROM Dogs
) dc
WHERE dc.age_num IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Treatments t WHERE t.dog_id = dc.dog_id)
